verdict.rationale: Terraform ships an official, first-party MCP server whose documented purpose includes enabling more accurate Terraform configuration generation by AI models. However, the natural-language generation itself is done by an external AI client, not an assistant built into the Terraform CLI or toolchain. missing for 10: a native built-in natural-language-to-HCL generation feature, documentation of the end-to-end prompt-to-code workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration of generation quality.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can generate infrastructure code from natural language using AI assistance built into the toolchain

citations.quote: AI enhancement: Enables more accurate and actionable Terraform configuration generation.
The Terraform Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enhances AI models with real-time access to current Terraform provider documentation, modules, and policies from the Terraform registry.
